title: Dabeecadda iyo xilliyada
description: Ten short, simple stories about nature and the seasons in the Somali countryside and towns: a dry well and the spring rains, a hyena at night, a Ramadan evening meal, eggs for breakfast at grandmother's, a wedding dress, a crocodile in the Shabeelle, a school trip to the Cal Madow mountains, a race on a cool October morning, a grandfather's hunting story and an old book of stories on a rainy day.

lessons.title: Roobka gu'
lessons.summary: In the dry season the well of Samatar's family near Oodweyne is empty; he and his father Raage dig a hole in the dry riverbed and draw water through a pipe for the sheep and the big billy goat, and then the spring rains come and the family is delighted.
lessons.text:
Samatar waa wiil laba iyo toban jir ah. Aabbaha Samatar waa Raage. Samatar iyo Raage waxay ku nool yihiin miyiga, meel u dhow Oodweyne. Reerku wuxuu leeyahay ido iyo ari. Ariga waxaa ku jira orgi weyn oo madow.

Hadda waa jiilaal. Dhulku waa qalalan yahay. Webiga yar ee meesha mara sidoo kale waa qalalan yahay. Ceelka reerka biyo kuma jiraan. Ceelku waa faaruq.

"Aabbe, ceelku waa faaruq," ayuu yidhi Samatar. "Idaha iyo ariga biyo ma heli doonaan."

"Waan ogahay," ayuu yidhi Raage. "Webiga qalalan ayaynu tagi doonnaa. Halkaas bohol baynu ka samayn doonnaa."

Subaxdii, Samatar iyo Raage waxay tageen webiga qalalan. Raage wuxuu sameeyay bohol weyn. Bohosha hoosteeda biyo yar ayaa ku jiray. "Biyo ayaa jira!" ayuu yidhi Samatar.

Raage wuxuu keenay tuuboo dheer. Tuuboo ayuu bohosha ku dhigay. Biyaha ayaa tuuboo ku dhex socday ilaa meesha xoolaha. Kadib Samatar iyo Raage waxay biyo ka waraabeen bohosha. Way waraabeen ilaa galabtii.

Idaha ayaa marka hore cabbay. Kadib ariga ayaa cabbay. Orgigu wuxuu rabay inuu marka hore cabbo, laakiin Samatar wuxuu yidhi: "Sug, orgi! Idaha ayaa marka hore cabba." Orgigii madow wuu sugay.

Maalin walba, Samatar iyo Raage waxay biyo ka waraabeen bohosha. Laakiin maalin walba biyo yar ayaa bohosha ku jiray. "Haddii roobka gu' uusan iman, waxba ma haysan doonno," ayuu yidhi Raage.

Habeen, daruuro madow ayaa cirka yimid. Kadib roob weyn ayaa da'ay. Waa roobka gu'. Webigii qalalan ahaa biyo ayaa ku socday. Ceelkii faaruqa ahaa biyo ayaa buuxiyay.

Samatar wuu riyaaqay. Raage sidoo kale wuu riyaaqay. Idaha, ariga iyo orgiga madow way cabbeen biyaha cusub. "Gu' waa xilli wanaagsan," ayuu yidhi Raage. "Gu' kadib, nolosha reerku way xasiloon tahay. Xoolaha caws ayay helayaan."

Nolosha reerka hadda waa xasiloon tahay. Samatar wuu riyaaqay, waayo hadda ceelka ayay biyo ka heli karaan.

Su'aalo:
Ceelka reerka maxaa ku jiray?
Ceelku wuxuu ahaa faaruq, biyo kuma jirin.
Raage meeshee buu bohosha ka sameeyay?
Raage wuxuu bohosha ka sameeyay webiga qalalan.
Maxay Samatar iyo Raage ka waraabeen bohosha?
Samatar iyo Raage waxay biyo ka waraabeen bohosha.
Yaa marka hore cabbay, idaha mise orgiga?
Idaha ayaa marka hore cabbay.
Maxaa yimid habeenkii?
Roobka gu' ayaa yimid.
Gu' kadib, nolosha reerku sidee bay tahay?
Gu' kadib, nolosha reerku waa xasiloon tahay.

lessons.title: Waraabaha habeenkii
lessons.summary: Ten-year-old Ugbaad stays with her grandmother Bullo near Gabiley; at night a hyena comes to the narrow gate of the goat pen while the lazy dog sleeps, the grandmother takes a candle to the doorway and shouts, and the hyena runs off without hurting a goat.
lessons.text:
Ugbaad waa gabadh toban jir ah. Bishan, waxay joogtaa ayeeyadeed Bullo, oo ku nool miyiga, meel u dhow Gabiley. Ayeeyo Bullo waxay leedahay ari iyo eey weyn. Eeygu waa caajis. Maalinta oo dhan wuu seexdaa.

Habeenkii ariga waxay ku seexdaan meel yar oo geedo laga sameeyay. Meeshaas waxay leedahay albaab ciriiri ah. Albaabka ciriiriga ah ariga ayaa ka gala.

Habeen, Ugbaad way toostay. Dibadda cod ayay ka maqashay. "Ayeeyo, waa maxay codkaas?" ayay tidhi.

"Waa waraabe," ayay tidhi Bullo. "Waraabaha ayaa ariga u yimid."

Bullo waxay shiday shumac. Shumaca ayay qaadatay, waxayna tagtay afaafka guriga. Ugbaad way raacday. Afaafka ayay ka eegeen dibadda.

Waraabaha wuxuu taagnaa albaabka ciriiriga ah. Iftiinka shumaca ayay Ugbaad ku aragtay ilko waaweyn oo cad. "Waraabaha ilko waaweyn ayuu leeyahay," ayay tidhi Ugbaad. "Ilko waaweyn ariga way dhaawici karaan." Ugbaad cabsi bay qabtay.

Eeygii caajiska ahaa wuu seexanayay. "Toos, eeyga caajiska ah!" ayay tidhi Bullo. Eeygu ma toosin.

Bullo afaafka ayay ka istaagtay, waxayna tidhi cod weyn: "Bax, waraabe! Bax!" Waraabaha cabsi ayuu qabtay, wuuna cararay. Albaabka ciriiriga ah ma uusan gelin. Ariga ma dhaawicin.

"Ariga waraabaha ma dhaawicin," ayay tidhi Bullo. Kadib waxay afuufay shumaca, guriguna mugdi buu noqday. "Shumaca ha afuufin, ayeeyo," ayay tidhi Ugbaad. "Cabsi baan qabaa."

Bullo way qososhay. Shumaca mar kale ayay shiday. "Goorma ayaad seexan doontaa?" ayay weydiisay.

"Waraabaha goorma ayuu yimaadaa?" ayay weydiisay Ugbaad.

"Habeenkii ayuu yimaadaa, marka uu cunto doonayo," ayay tidhi Bullo. "Laakiin albaabku waa ciriiri, anigana waan toosaa. Hadda seexo." Ugbaad way seexatay. Subaxdii, Bullo waxay afuufay shumacii, eeygii caajiska ahaana weli wuu seexanayay.

Su'aalo:
Eeyga ayeeyo Bullo sidee buu yahay?
Eeygu waa caajis, maalinta oo dhan wuu seexdaa.
Albaabka meesha ariga sidee buu yahay?
Albaabku waa ciriiri.
Bullo maxay qaadatay markay tagtay afaafka?
Bullo waxay qaadatay shumac.
Maxay Ugbaad ku aragtay iftiinka shumaca?
Ugbaad waxay ku aragtay ilko waaweyn oo cad.
Waraabaha goorma ayuu yimaadaa?
Waraabaha habeenkii ayuu yimaadaa.

lessons.title: Afurka abtiga
lessons.summary: In Ramadan, eleven-year-old Tahliil and his mother go to his uncle Kaahin's house in Hargeysa for the evening meal; his aunt Cawo cooks chicken with garlic and salt, the uncle makes pasta, Tahliil makes a lemon drink with honey, and after the meal the grown-ups drink coffee.
lessons.text:
Tahliil waa wiil kow iyo toban jir ah oo ku nool Hargeysa. Waa bisha soonka. Maalintii dadku waxba ma cunaan, waxna ma cabbaan. Fiidkii, marka qorraxdu dhacdo, waxay cunaan afurka.

Maanta Tahliil iyo hooyadiis waxay u tageen guriga abtigiis Kaahin. Kaahin waa walaalka hooyada Tahliil. Eeddadiis Cawo sidoo kale way timid. Cawo waa walaasha aabbaha Tahliil.

Abtiga iyo eeddada ayaa sameeyay afurka. Eeddo Cawo waxay samaysay digaag. Digaagga waxay ku dartay toon iyo cusbo. "Toon badan baan jeclahay," ayay tidhi. Abti Kaahin wuxuu sameeyay baasto. Baastada wuxuu ku daray cusbo yar iyo toon.

Tahliil wuxuu sameeyay cabitaan liin ah. Liinta wuu jaray, biyo iyo sonkor buuna ku daray. Eeddo Cawo waxay tidhi: "Sonkor ha ku darin. Malab ku dar. Malabku sonkorta wuu ka fiican yahay." Tahliil wuxuu ku daray malab. Cabitaanka liinta iyo malabka waa macaan yahay.

Fiidkii, qorraxdu way dhacday. "Waa waqtiga afurka," ayuu yidhi abti Kaahin. Qoysku wuxuu cunay afurka: digaagga, baastada iyo cabitaanka liinta. Tahliil wuxuu cunay digaag badan. "Digaagga eeddo Cawo ayaa ugu fiican," ayuu yidhi. Hooyadiis way qososhay.

Afurka kadib, abti Kaahin wuxuu sameeyay kafee. Kafeega wuxuu ku daray malab yar. Dadka waaweyn ayaa kafee cabbay. Tahliil kafee ma cabbin. "Kafee ma jecli," ayuu yidhi. "Cabitaanka liinta ayaan jeclahay."

Abtigiis iyo eeddadiis way qosleen. "Berri mar kale kaalay," ayay tidhi eeddo Cawo. "Afurka berri, digaag iyo toon baan samayn doonaa, abtigaana baasto ayuu samayn doonaa."

Su'aalo:
Yaa ah abtiga Tahliil?
Abtiga Tahliil waa Kaahin.
Eeddo Cawo maxay ku dartay digaagga?
Eeddo Cawo waxay digaagga ku dartay toon iyo cusbo.
Abti Kaahin muxuu sameeyay?
Abti Kaahin wuxuu sameeyay baasto iyo kafee.
Maxaa Tahliil ku daray cabitaanka liinta?
Tahliil wuxuu cabitaanka liinta ku daray malab.
Tahliil kafee ma cabbay?
Maya, Tahliil kafee ma cabbin.

lessons.title: Quraacda ayeeyo
lessons.summary: Nine-year-old Shamsa from Hargeysa visits her ninety-year-old grandmother Dhuuxo in a village near Sheekh; in the morning they clean their teeth with a twig, collect eggs from the hens in the yard, keep the shells for the trees and eat eggs, bread and the cheese Shamsa brought, and then Shamsa cuts her grandmother's long nails.
lessons.text:
Shamsa waa gabadh sagaal jir ah oo ku nool Hargeysa. Ayeeyadeed Dhuuxo waxay ku nooshahay tuulo yar oo u dhow Sheekh. Ayeeyo Dhuuxo waa sagaashan jir. Sagaashan sano! Waa duq, laakiin weli way xoog badan tahay.

Xilliga gu', Shamsa iyo hooyadeed waxay u tageen tuulada. Shamsa waxay keentay farmaajo. "Ayeeyo farmaajo way jeceshahay," ayay tidhi hooyadeed.

Subaxdii hore, ayeeyo Dhuuxo way toostay. Waxay qaadatay caday. Caday waa qayb yar oo geed ah. Dadka miyiga caday ayay ilko ku dhaqaan. Shamsa waxay tidhi: "Ayeeyo, anigana caday i sii." Ayeeyo waxay siisay caday. Shamsa iyo ayeeyadeed waxay ilko ku dhaqeen caday.

Kadib waxay u baxeen saaxada guriga. Saaxada digaag badan ayaa ku jira. Digaaggu subax walba ukun ayuu dhalaa. "Ukunta soo qaad," ayay tidhi ayeeyo. Shamsa waxay saaxada ka heshay shan ukun.

Ayeeyo ukunta dab ayay saartay. Kadib waxay ukunta ka qaadday qolofta. "Qolofta i sii," ayay tidhi. "Qolofta ukunta geedaha ayaan siiyaa. Qoloftu way u fiican tahay geedaha." Shamsa qolofta waxay dhigtay geedaha saaxada hoostooda.

Waa waqtiga quraacda. Quraacda waxay cuneen ukun, rooti iyo farmaajo. Ayeeyo Dhuuxo farmaajada way jeclaatay. "Quraac fiican!" ayay tidhi. "Farmaajada magaalada waa macaan tahay."

Kadib ayeeyo gacanteeda ayay saartay dhabanka Shamsa. Shamsa sidoo kale gacanteeda ayay saartay dhabanka ayeeyadeed. Dhabankeeda waa jilicsan yahay.

Shamsa waxay aragtay gacmaha ayeeyo. Ciddiyaha ayeeyo way dheer yihiin. "Ayeeyo, ciddiyahaagu way dheer yihiin," ayay tidhi Shamsa. "Aniga ayaa jari doona." Shamsa waxay jartay ciddiyaha ayeeyadeed. Ayeeyo Dhuuxo way faraxsanayd. "Gabadh fiican baad tahay," ayay tidhi.

Su'aalo:
Ayeeyo Dhuuxo waa sideed iyo toban jir mise sagaashan jir?
Ayeeyo Dhuuxo waa sagaashan jir.
Ayeeyo maxay ilko ku dhaqdaa?
Ayeeyo waxay ilko ku dhaqdaa caday.
Shamsa saaxada maxay ka heshay?
Shamsa waxay saaxada ka heshay shan ukun.
Maxay cuneen quraacda?
Quraacda waxay cuneen ukun, rooti iyo farmaajo.
Shamsa maxay u samaysay ayeeyadeed?
Shamsa waxay jartay ciddiyaha ayeeyadeed.

lessons.title: Gaafka Sharmaarke
lessons.summary: Sharmaarke, a thirty-year-old bachelor in Burco, is getting married to Laylo; his sister Jawaahir buys cheap beige cloth and a new needle and sews the bride's dress, and at the gaaf, when the bride is brought to her new home with her bags, Laylo thanks her.
lessons.text:
Sharmaarke waa barbaar soddon jir ah oo ku nool Burco. Saaxiibbadiis oo dhan xaas bay leeyihiin, laakiin Sharmaarke weli waa doob. "Doob baad tahay, Sharmaarke," ayay dadku yidhaahdaan. "Guurso!"

Sharmaarke wuxuu jecel yahay gabadh la yidhaahdo Laylo. Dayrta, guurkooda ayaa dhici doona. Laylo waxay noqon doontaa afadiisa.

Walaashiis Jawaahir waxay jeceshahay tolidda. Tolidda dharka way ku fiican tahay. "Dharka Laylo aniga ayaa samayn doona," ayay tidhi Jawaahir.

Jawaahir waxay tagtay suuqa. Waxay rabtay maro cawl ah. Suuqa waxay ka heshay maro cawl ah oo raqiis ah. "Maradani waa raqiis," ayay tidhi. "Cawl waa midab qurxoon." Waxay sidoo kale iibsatay irbad cusub, waayo irbaddii hore way jabtay. Irbadda cusubi sidoo kale waa raqiis.

Jawaahir waxay bilowday tolidda. Maalin walba irbadda ayay qaadatay, waxayna samaynaysay dharka cawlka ah. Toddoba maalin kadib, tolidda way dhammaysay.

Maalintii gaafka way timid. Gaafka waa marka naagta cusub loo keeno guriga ninkeeda. Dad badan ayaa yimid. Barbaarta iyo gabdho badan ayaa heeso qaaday. Laylo waxay xidhatay dharka cawlka ah. Dharkeeda kale wuxuu ku jiray shandado waaweyn. Sharmaarke ayaa shandadaha qaaday.

Gaafka kadib, Laylo waxay u timid Jawaahir. "Mahadsanid, Jawaahir," ayay tidhi. "Dharkani waa qurxoon yahay." Jawaahir way faraxsanayd. "Mahadsanid, Laylo. Hadda waxaad tahay walaashay," ayay tidhi.

Sharmaarke hadda doob ma aha. Laylo waa afadiisa. "Afadayda waan jeclahay," ayuu yidhi. "Mahadsanid, walaashay, dharka qurxoon."

Su'aalo:
Sharmaarke muxuu ahaa?
Sharmaarke wuxuu ahaa barbaar doob ah.
Jawaahir maxay jeceshahay?
Jawaahir waxay jeceshahay tolidda.
Marada Jawaahir iibsatay sidee bay ahayd?
Marada Jawaahir iibsatay waxay ahayd cawl iyo raqiis.
Gaafka maxaa dhaca?
Gaafka, naagta cusub ayaa loo keenaa guriga ninkeeda.
Laylo maxay ku tidhi Jawaahir?
Laylo waxay ku tidhi Jawaahir: "Mahadsanid."
Yaa qaaday shandadaha Laylo?
Sharmaarke ayaa qaaday shandadaha Laylo.

lessons.title: Yaxaaska webiga
lessons.summary: In the spring rains Sabriye takes the family's cow and ox, now fat again after the dry season, to the Shabeelle river at Beledweyne; while he puts his arm in the water to catch a fish he does not see a crocodile, the old fisherman Galaal shouts, the ox turns away, and Galaal tells him he was lucky.
lessons.text:
Sabriye waa wiil saddex iyo toban jir ah oo ku nool Beledweyne. Reerkiisu wuxuu leeyahay lo'. Lo'da waxaa ku jira sac cad iyo dibi weyn oo madow.

Jiilaalka, caws ma jirin. Saca iyo dibiga way caato ahaayeen. Sacii caatada ahaa caano yar buu bixin jiray. Hadda waa gu', roob badan ayaana da'ay. Caws badan ayaa jira. Saca iyo dibiga hadda waa buuran yihiin. "Dibigu waa buuran yahay, sacuna waa buuran yahay," ayuu yidhi Sabriye. Wuu faraxsanaa.

Galabtii, Sabriye wuxuu saca iyo dibiga u keenay webiga Shabeelle si ay biyo u cabbaan. Wuxuu sidoo kale rabay inuu malay qabto. Webiga dhinaciisa, oday la yidhaahdo Galaal ayaa malay qabanayay.

Saca iyo dibiga way cabbeen. Sabriye cududdiisa ayuu biyaha ku dhex dhigay. "Malay baan gacanta ku qaban doonaa," ayuu yidhi. Cududdiisa oo dhan ayaa biyaha ku jirtay.

Sabriye wuu ka moogaa waxa biyaha ku jira. Biyaha hoostooda yaxaas weyn ayaa ku jira. Yaxaasku wuxuu u socday dhinaca Sabriye. Sabriye weli wuu ka moogaa.

Galaal ayaa arkay yaxaaska. "Sabriye! Yaxaas! Cududda ka soo saar biyaha!" ayuu yidhi cod weyn. Sabriye cududdiisa ayuu ka soo saaray biyaha, wuuna cararay. Dibiga ayaa yaxaaska arkay, wuuna ka leexanayay webiga. Saca sidoo kale wuu ka leexanayay. Labadooduba waxay u socdeen dhinaca cawska.

Yaxaasku wuxuu dib ugu noqday biyaha. Galaal wuxuu u yimid Sabriye. "Ayaan baad leedahay, wiilkayga," ayuu yidhi. "Ayaanka ayaa ku caawiyay. Yaxaasku cududdaada wuu cuni lahaa."

"Waan ka moogaa yaxaaska," ayuu yidhi Sabriye. "Waxaan doonayay malay oo kaliya. Ayaankayga waa wanaagsan yahay."

Galaal wuu qoslay. "Webiga Shabeelle yaxaas badan ayaa ku jira. Ha ka moogaan." Kadib wuxuu Sabriye siiyay saddex malay oo uu qabtay. "Malaygan qaado," ayuu yidhi. Sabriye wuxuu malayga iyo lo'da u keenay guriga.

Su'aalo:
Jiilaalka saca iyo dibiga sidee bay ahaayeen?
Jiilaalka saca iyo dibiga way caato ahaayeen.
Gu' kadib, saca iyo dibiga sidee bay yihiin?
Saca iyo dibiga hadda waa buuran yihiin.
Sabriye muxuu ka moog ahaa?
Sabriye wuxuu ka moog ahaa yaxaaska.
Dibiga muxuu sameeyay markuu arkay yaxaaska?
Dibiga wuxuu ka leexanayay webiga.
Galaal muxuu siiyay Sabriye?
Galaal wuxuu Sabriye siiyay saddex malay.
Sabriye muxuu ka yidhi ayaankiisa?
Sabriye wuxuu yidhi: "Ayaankayga waa wanaagsan yahay."

lessons.title: Caarada Cal Madow
lessons.summary: On a Wednesday the teacher Fiqi from Boosaaso takes his class to the Cal Madow mountains to study the different trees and animals; Iftin, who got a zero in the last test because of her mistakes, learns how a spider is useful, studies all Friday and makes no mistake in Saturday's test.
lessons.text:
Iftin waa gabadh shan iyo toban jir ah oo ku nool Boosaaso. Macallinkeeda waa Fiqi. Ardayda Fiqi waxay waxbartaan geedaha, xayawaanka iyo dhulka.

Toddobaadkii hore, Iftin waxay heshay eber. Su'aalaha oo dhan gaf bay ku samaysay. "Eber!" ayay tidhi. "Gaf badan baan sameeyay."

"Iskuday mar kale," ayuu yidhi Fiqi. "Arbacada waxaynu u safri doonnaa Cal Madow. Waa inaad halkaas wax badan ka waxbarto."

Cal Madow waa buuro dhaadheer oo ka mid ah dhulka Soomaaliya. Afka Soomaaliga, cal waa buur. Cal Madow waa buur madow.

Arbacada subax hore, ardayda iyo Fiqi waxay u safreen buuraha. Buuraha korkooda hawadu waa qabow. Geedo kaladuwan ayaa jira. Xayawaan kaladuwan ayaa jira. "Buuraha Cal Madow waxaa ku nool xayawaan kaladuwan," ayuu yidhi Fiqi.

Iftin waxay aragtay caaro weyn oo ku jirta laba geed dhexdooda. "Macallin, caaradu faa'ido ma leedahay?" ayay weydiisay.

"Haa," ayuu yidhi Fiqi. "Caaradu faa'ido weyn bay leedahay. Waxay cuntaa kaneecada. Taasi waa faa'idada caarada." Iftin waxay buuggeeda ku qortay: "Caaro: faa'ido weyn."

Galabtii, Fiqi wuxuu yidhi: "Sabtida su'aalo ayaan idin weydiin doonaa." Iftin way iskudaysay. Khamiista iyo jimcaha way waxbartay. Jimcaha oo dhan guriga ayay joogtay, buuggeeda ayayna akhriday. "Jimcaha dugsi ma jiro," ayay tidhi hooyadeed. "Haa, hooyo, laakiin waa inaan waxbarto," ayay tidhi Iftin.

Sabtida, Fiqi wuxuu weydiiyay su'aalaha. Iftin gaf ma samayn. Eber ma helin. "Waad iskudaysay, Iftin," ayuu yidhi Fiqi. "Hadda gaf ma lihid."

Su'aalo:
Toddobaadkii hore Iftin maxay heshay?
Toddobaadkii hore Iftin waxay heshay eber.
Ardayda goorma ayay u safreen Cal Madow?
Ardayda waxay u safreen Cal Madow arbacada.
Afka Soomaaliga, cal waa maxay?
Afka Soomaaliga, cal waa buur.
Caaradu faa'ido ma leedahay?
Haa, caaradu faa'ido weyn bay leedahay, waxay cuntaa kaneecada.
Iftin maxay samaysay jimcaha?
Jimcaha Iftin way waxbartay.

lessons.title: Tartamida orodka
lessons.summary: On a cool Sunday in October, Cabdinaasir, a young man with a beard, runs in a race in Hargeysa for a prize of one million shillings; the arrogant runner Hirsi and his stooge Tahir call him a fool, but Hirsi stops to show off, and Cabdinaasir, pressing the button on his watch, finishes first.
lessons.text:
Cabdinaasir waa nin dhallinyar ah oo ku nool Hargeysa. Wuxuu leeyahay gadh madow. Gadh dheer ma aha, laakiin waa gadh fiican. Cabdinaasir orodka aad buu u jecel yahay. Subax walba wuu ordaa.

Bisha oktoobar, Hargeysa waxaa ka dhici doonta tartamida orodka. Tartamida waxay dhici doontaa axadda. Ninka kowaad ah wuxuu heli doonaa hal malyuun oo shilin. "Hal malyuun!" ayuu yidhi Cabdinaasir. "Waan tartami doonaa."

Bisha oktoobar, hawada Hargeysa way qabow tahay. Hawada qabow waxay fududeysaa orodka. "Hawadu orodka way fududeysaa," ayuu yidhi Cabdinaasir.

Axaddii subaxdii, dad badan ayaa yimid. Nin la yidhaahdo Hirsi ayaa sidoo kale tartami doona. Hirsi waa nin kibir badan. Mar walba wuxuu yidhaahdaa: "Aniga ayaa ugu fiican." Hirsi wuxuu leeyahay dabadhilif la yidhaahdo Tahir. Tahir wuxuu ku raacaa meel walba, wuxuuna yidhaahdaa: "Haa, Hirsi waa ugu fiican."

Hirsi wuxuu eegay Cabdinaasir. "Ninkan gadh leh waa nacas," ayuu yidhi. "Nacas baa malyuunka helaya?" Tahir, dabadhilifka Hirsi, wuu qoslay. "Haa, waa nacas," ayuu yidhi.

Cabdinaasir waxba ma odhan. Saacaddiisa ayuu eegay. Saacadda badhan yar ayaa ku yaal. Tartamidu markay bilowday, Cabdinaasir badhanka ayuu riixay.

Hirsi aad buu u ordey. Kadib wuu istaagay, wuxuuna dadka u sheegay inuu isagu yahay kan ugu fiican. Kibirkiisa ayaa waqti ka qaatay. Cabdinaasir ma istaagin. Hawada qabow ayaa orodka u fududeysay.

Cabdinaasir ayaa noqday kowaad. Mar kale ayuu riixay badhanka saacadda. Wuxuu helay hal malyuun oo shilin. Hirsi wuxuu noqday saddexaad. Tahir, dabadhilifkii, waxba ma odhan.

"Nin gadh leh nacas ma aha," ayuu yidhi Cabdinaasir, wuuna qoslay. "Kibir la'aan baan ordaa."

Su'aalo:
Tartamida orodka goorma ayay dhacday?
Tartamida orodka waxay dhacday axad, bisha oktoobar.
Ninka kowaad ah muxuu helayaa?
Ninka kowaad ah wuxuu helayaa hal malyuun oo shilin.
Yaa ah dabadhilifka Hirsi?
Dabadhilifka Hirsi waa Tahir.
Hirsi muxuu ku yidhi Cabdinaasir?
Hirsi wuxuu yidhi: "Ninkan gadh leh waa nacas."
Maxaa orodka u fududeysay?
Hawada qabow ayaa orodka fududeysay.

lessons.title: Ugaadhsigii awoowe
lessons.summary: Old Geedi near Jigjiga tells his grandson Muumin how, as a young man, he went hunting with his father: they shot an animal, cut it with a knife, kept the skin and fat, his mother roasted the meat, a wolf came at night, Geedi shot at it and killed a neighbour's goat instead, and his father paid compensation.
lessons.text:
Geedi waa oday ku nool miyiga, meel u dhow Jigjiga. Habeen, wiilka wiilkiisa Muumin ayaa yidhi: "Sheeko ii sheeg."

"Waxaan kuu sheegi doonaa sheeko ku saabsan ugaadh," ayuu yidhi Geedi.

"Markaan barbaar ahaa, aabbahay iyo aniga ugaadh ayaannu u bixi jirnay. Aabbahay qori buu lahaa. Maalin, xayawaan weyn ayaannu duurka ku aragnay. Aabbahay wuu tooganayay, laakiin xayawaanka wuu cararay. Mar kale ayuu tooganayay. Markaas xayawaanku wuu dhacay."

"Aabbahay wuxuu qaatay mindi. Mindida ayuu xayawaanka ku jaray. Haragga ayuu ka qaaday. Harag weyn buu ahaa. Hooyaday haragga waxay ka samaysay meel lagu fadhiisto. Hilibka waxaa ku jiray baruur badan. Baruurta iyo hilibka guriga ayaannu keennay."

"Hooyaday hilibka way dubtay. Dab ayay ku dubtay. Hilibkii ay dubtay aad buu u macaan ahaa. Baruurta sidoo kale way dubtay."

"Habeenkii yey ayaa yimid. Yeyga wuxuu doonayay hilibka. Aniga qori baan qaatay. Yeyga ayaan tooganayay. Laakiin yeyga ma dhimanin. Wuu cararay. Orgi uu lahaa nin guri dhow ku nool ayaa dhintay."

Muumin wuu qoslay. "Awoowe! Maxaa dhacay markaas?"

"Aabbahay wuxuu ninka siiyay mag. Magta waxay ahayd laba orgi. Aabbahay wuxuu yidhi: Geedi, qori ha qaadan mar kale. Ugaadh ma tagi doontid ilaa aad weynaato."

"Doofaar ma ugaadhay?" ayuu weydiiyay Muumin.

"Maya. Doofaar ma cunno. Duurka doofaaro badan ayaa ku nool, laakiin doofaarka waannu ka tagi jirnay."

Su'aalo:
Geedi iyo aabbaha Geedi maxay u bixi jireen?
Geedi iyo aabbaha Geedi waxay u bixi jireen ugaadh.
Aabbaha Geedi muxuu xayawaanka ku jaray?
Aabbaha Geedi wuxuu xayawaanka ku jaray mindi.
Hooyada Geedi maxay ka samaysay haragga?
Hooyada Geedi haragga waxay ka samaysay meel lagu fadhiisto.
Yaa yimid habeenkii?
Habeenkii yey ayaa yimid.
Aabbaha Geedi muxuu siiyay ninkii orgigu u dhintay?
Aabbaha Geedi wuxuu ninka siiyay mag: laba orgi.

lessons.title: Buugga duugga ah
lessons.summary: In the autumn rains in Baraawe, the old Quran teacher Calasow keeps the children inside and reads from an old printed book the story of Ibrahim, who broke his people's idols and was visited by angels; he explains what an idol is, and says such stories are good upbringing.
lessons.text:
Calasow waa macallin duq ah oo ku nool Baraawe. Wuxuu carruurta baraa diinta. Xilliga dayrta, roob badan ayaa da'a. Maanta roob baa jira, sidaas darteed carruurtu waxay joogaan qolka gudihiisa.

Calasow wuxuu leeyahay buug duug ah. Buugga duugga ah wuxuu ahaa buugga aabbaha Calasow. Daabicida buuggan waxay dhacday lixdan sano ka hor. Buuggu wuxuu leeyahay sheekooyin diin ah.

Sheegidda sheekooyinka waa waxa Calasow ugu jecel yahay. "Maanta sheegidda sheekada Ibraahim ayaan samayn doonaa," ayuu yidhi.

"Waqti hore, dadka Ibraahim waxay u tukan jireen sanam. Sanamyada waxaa laga sameeyay dhagax iyo geed. Ibraahim wuxuu yidhi: Sanamku ma hadli karo, wax ma arki karo. Habeen, Ibraahim wuxuu jebiyay sanamyada."

Wiil yar oo la yidhaahdo Ugaas ayaa weydiiyay: "Macallin, sanam waa maxay?"

Calasow wuu caddeyay. "Sanam waa wax dadku sameeyeen, kadibna u tukadaan. Dahirka arrintu waa sidan: sanamku waxba ma qaban karo. Taasi waa dahir. Dahirku waa muhiim."

"Mar kale, malaa'ig ayaa u yimid Ibraahim. Ibraahim ma garanayn inay malaa'ig yihiin. Hilib ayuu u keenay. Laakiin malaa'igtu ma cunin. Malaa'igta ayaa caddeysay: Waxaannu nahay malaa'ig."

Carruurtu way dhagaysteen. Ugaas wuxuu yidhi: "Macallin, sheekadan waan jeclahay."

Calasow wuxuu yidhi: "Sheekooyinkan waa tarbiyad wanaagsan. Tarbiyadda carruurta waa muhiim. Buuggan duugga ah tarbiyad buu bixiyaa."

Calasow wuxuu sidoo kale qoray buug cusub oo sheekooyin ah. "Sannadka dambe buuggayga cusub waa la daabici doonaa," ayuu yidhi. "Daabicida kadib, carruur badan ayaa akhrin doonta."

Su'aalo:
Buugga Calasow sidee buu yahay?
Buugga Calasow waa duug.
Dadka Ibraahim yay u tukan jireen?
Dadka Ibraahim waxay u tukan jireen sanam.
Yaa caddeyay waxa sanam yahay?
Calasow ayaa caddeyay waxa sanam yahay.
Yaa u yimid Ibraahim?
Malaa'ig ayaa u yimid Ibraahim.
Calasow muxuu ka yidhi sheekooyinka?
Calasow wuxuu yidhi sheekooyinkan waa tarbiyad wanaagsan.
Maxaa Calasow ugu jecel yahay?
Calasow wuxuu ugu jecel yahay sheegidda sheekooyinka.
